Amharic: በተጨማሪ እንደ ኮቪድ-19 ላሉ አዳዲስ ወረርሽኞች ማህበረሰቡ እንዴት ምላሽ ሊሰጥ እንደሚችል ማወቁ አስፈላጊ ነው ብለዋል፡፡

Source: In this study, the researchers assessed the knowledge, attitudes and practices of Ethiopians when it comes to Covid-19 disease.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza beekaliriza okumanya, entwala n’ebikolwa bya bannansi ba Ethiopia bwe kituuka ku ndwadde ya Covid-19.
Yoruba: Nínú iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí, àwọn aṣèwádìí náà ṣàyẹ̀wò ìmọ̀, àwọn ìwùwàsí àti ìse àwọn ará ilẹ̀ Ethiopia bí ọ̀rọ̀ bá kan àrùn COVID-19.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, abancwaningi bahlole ulwazi, isimo senqondo nemikhuba yokwenza kwabantu base-Ethiopia uma kuziwa ezifeni ezinjenge-Covid-19.
Hausa: A cikin wannan binciken, masu binciken sun tantance ilimi, halaye da ayyukan Habasha idan ana maganar cutar Covid-19.
Northern Sotho: Ka mo dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši ba sekasekile tsebo, maikutlo le ditiro tša badudi ba Ethiopia ge re etla go bolwetši bja Covid-19.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት ተመራማሪዎቹ ኢትዮጵያውያን የኮቪድ-19 በሽታን በተመለከተ ያላቸውን እውቀት፣ አመለካከቶች እና ተግባሮች ገምግመዋል፡፡

Source: They conducted a telephonic survey between May and June, 2020, in 9 districts and 2 cities in Ethiopia.
Luganda: Baakokola okunoonyereza okw’oku ssimu wakati w’Ogwokutaano n’Ogwomukaaga, 2020 mu disitulikiti 9 n’ebibuga 2 mu Ethiopia.
Yoruba: Wọ́n fi ìpè sórí ẹ̀rọ ìbánisọ̀rọ̀ ṣe ìwádìí láàrin oṣù Èbìbí sí oṣù Okúdù, ọdún 2020, ní àwọn agbègbè mésàn-án àti àwọn ìlú-ńlá méjì ní Ethiopia.
Zulu: Benze inhlolovo ngocingo phakathi kukaNhlaba noNhlangulana, wezi-2020, kwizifunda ezi-9 nase madolobheni ama-2 e-Ethiopia.
Hausa: Sun gudanar da binciken wayar tarho a tsakanin watan Mayu da Yuni, 2020, a gundumomi 9 da birane 2 a Habasha.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba dira dinyakišišo ka mogala magareng ga Mei le June, 2020, ka dileteng tše 9 le ka ditoropokgolong tše 2 ka Ethiopia.
Amharic: በሜይ እና ጁን 2020 ባለው ጊዜ ውስጥ በኢትዮጵያ በ9 ወረዳዎች እና በ2 ከተሞች የስልክ የዳሰሳ ጥናት አካሂደዋል፡፡

Source: The researchers asked participants about their personal characteristics like age and gender.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baabuuza abeetabi ebintu ebibakwatako gamba ng’emyaka n’ekikula.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà bí àwọn akópa léèrè nípa àwọn àbùdá àdání wọn bí ọjọ́-orí àti ìṣakọṣabo.
Zulu: Abacwaningi babuze labo abebeyingxenye ulwazi lwabo siqu njenge minyaka kanye nobulili.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun tambayi mahalarta game da halayensu na sirri kamar shekaru da jinsi.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba botšišitše bakgathatema ka ga dimelo tša bona tša go swana le mengwaga le bong.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ተሳታፊዎቹን እንደ እድሜ እና ጾታ ስላሉ የግል መለያ ባህሪዎቻቸው ጠይቀዋቸዋል፡፡

Source: They also asked them how much they knew about Covid-19, and assessed their attitudes and practices toward Covid-19.
Luganda: Mu ngeri endala era baababuuza obungi bw’ekyo kye baali bamanyi ku Covid-19, era ne beekaliriza entwala n’ebikolwa byabwe eri Covid-19.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún bi wọ́n ni ohun tí wọ́n nípa COVID-19, wọ́n sì ṣe àyẹ̀wò àwọn ìwà àti ìse wọn sí Covid-19.
Zulu: Baphinde bababuza futhi ukuthi bebazi kangakanani nge-Covid-19, base behlola isimo sabo senqondo nomkhuba abawenzayo uma kubheke kwi-Covid-19.
Hausa: Sun kuma tambaye su nawa suka sani game da cutar Covid-19, kuma sun tantance halayensu da ayyukansu game da cutar Covid-19.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba ba botšiša gape gore ba tseba kudu bjang ka ga Covid-19, gomme ba lekola maikutlo a bona le ditiro mabapi le Covid-19.
Amharic: ስለ ኮቪድ-19 ምን ያህል እንደሚያውቁ ጠይቀውም ስለ ኮቪድ-19 ያላቸውን አመለካከቶች እና ተግባሮች ገምግመዋል፡፡

Source: Their results showed that only 42% of respondents had good knowledge about Covid-19.
Luganda: Bye baazuula byalaga nti abeetabi abakola ebitundu 42% bokka be baalina okumanya okusaanidde ku Covid-19.
Yoruba: Àbájáde wọn fi hàn pé 42% péré nínú àwọn olùdáhùn ni wọhn ní ìmọ̀ tó péye nípa Covid-19.
Zulu: Imiphumela yabo ikhombise ukuthi ama-42% kuphela wabaphendulile abebe nolwazi oluhle nge-Covid-19.
Hausa: Sakamakonsu ya nuna cewa kashi 42% ne kawai na waɗanda suka amsa suke da kyakkyawar masaniya game da cutar Covid-19.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo tša bona di aleditše gore ke fgela 42% ya baarabi yeo e bego e na le tsebo ye kaone ka ga Covid-19.
Amharic: ውጤታቸው እንደሚያሳየው ምላሽ ከሰጡት ሰዎች መካከል 42% ብቻ ስለ ኮቪድ-19 ጥሩ እውቀት ነበራቸው፡፡

Source: Females, elders, and those who did not go to university knew less.
Luganda: Abakyala, abakadde, n’abo abataasoma kutuuka ku yunivaasite baali bamanyi kitono.
Yoruba: Àwọn obìnrin, àwọn àgbàlagbà, àti àwọn tí wọn kò lọ ilé-ìwé gíga kò mọ ohun púpọ̀.
Zulu: Abesifazane, abadala, nalabo abangakaze baye emanyuvesi bebazi kancane.
Hausa: Mata, dattijai, da waɗanda ba su je jami'a kaɗan suka sani.
Northern Sotho: Basadi, batšofadi, le bao ba bego ba se ba ya yunibesithi ba be ba tseba gannyane.
Amharic: ሴቶች፣ ሽማግሌዎች እና ዩኒቨርሲቲ ያልገቡት የሚያውቁት ነገር ብዙም አይደለም፡፡

Source: The researchers reported that 73.6% of the people said they had heard about Covid-19, but only 42.4% knew how it could be passed from one person to another, and only 37.8% knew about Covid-19 symptoms.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti abantu abakola ebitundu 73.6% baagamba nti baali baawulira ku kubaawo kwa Covid-19, naye ebitundu 42.4% be baali bamanyi engeri gy’ayinza okusaasaana okuva ku muntu omu okudda ku mulala, ate era ng’abantu abakola ebitundu 37.8% bokka be baalina kye bamanyi ku bubonero bwa Covid-19.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí jábọ̀ pé 73.6% àwọn ènìyàn ni wọ́n ti gbọ́ nípa Covid-19, àmọ́ àwọn 42.4% péré ni wọ́n mọ bí ó ṣe lè ràn láti ọ̀dọ̀ ẹnìkan sí ẹlòmìíràn, àwọ 37.8% péré sì ni wọ́n mọ̀ nípa àwọn àmì àìsàn Covid-19.
Zulu: Abacwaningi babike ukuthi ama-73.6% wabantu uthe uke wezwa nge-Covid-19, kodwa ama-42.4% kuphela obuwazi ukuthi ingadluliseka kanjani komunye umuntu iye komunye, mase kuba ama-37.8% kuphela abebazi ngezimpawu ze-Covid-19.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ba da rahoton cewa kashi 73.6% na mutanen sun ce sun ji labarin cutar Covid-19, amma kashi 42.4% ne kawai suka san yadda za a iya yaɗa ta daga mutum ɗaya zuwa wani, kuma kashi 37.8% ne kawai suka san alamun cutar Covid-19.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba begile gore 73.6% ya batho ba boletše gore ba ile ba kwa ka ga Covid-19, eupša ke fela ba 42.4% bao ba bego ba tseba ka fao e ka fetišetšwago go motho yo mongwe, gomme ke fela ba 37.8% bao ba bego ba tseba ka ga maswao a Covid-19.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ 73.6% የሚሆኑት ሰዎች ስለ ኮቪድ-19 ሰምተናል ማለታቸውን ሪፖርት ቢያደርጉም ከአንድ ሰው ወደ ሌላው እንዴት እንደሚተላለፍ የሚያውቁት 42.4% የሚሆኑት ብቻ ሲሆኑ ስለ ኮቪድ-19 የህመም ምልክቶች የሚያውቁት ደግሞ 37.8% የሚሆኑት ብቻ ናቸው፡፡

Source: Only 14% said they knew that a person who showed no symptoms could still pass on the virus.
Luganda: Abantu abakole ebitundu 14% bokka be baagamba nti baali bakimanyi bulungi nti omuntu atalina kabonero konna akyasobola okusaasaana akawuka.
Yoruba: Àwọn 14% péré ni wọ́n sọ pé àwọn mọ̀ pé ẹni ti àmì aìsàn kankan kò yọ lára ṣì lè tan kòkòrò náà ká.
Zulu: I-14% kuphela elishilo ukuthi bebazi ukuthi umuntu obengakhombisi zimpawu kodwa ubesangakwazi ukudlulisa igciwane.
Hausa: Kashi 14% kawai ne suka ce sun san cewa mutumin da bai nuna alamun cutar ba har yanzu yana iya kamuwa da cutar.
Northern Sotho: Ke fela ba 14% bao ba boletšego gore ba a tseba gore motho yo a se nago maswao a bolwetši a ka tšwela pele go fetiša baerase.
Amharic: ምንም ምልክት ያላሳየ ሰውም ቢሆን ቫይረሱን ሊያስተላልፍ እንደሚችል እንደሚያውቁ የተናገሩት 14% የሚሆኑት ብቻ ነበሩ፡፡

Source: The researchers said 63.8% of participants knew that Covid-19 could be prevented through handwashing, social distancing, avoiding crowds, and using a face mask.
Luganda: Abnoonyereza baagamba nti abeetabi abakola ebitundu 63.8% baali bakimanyi nti Covid-19 asobola okutangirwa okuyita mu kunaaba engalo, okwewa amabanga, okwewala okubeera mu bantu abangi, awamu n’okukozesa akakookolo.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà sọ pé 63.8% àwọn akópa ni wọ́n mọ̀ pé ọwọ́ fífọ̀, ìtakéte síra ẹni, yíyẹra fún ọ̀pọ̀ èrò àti lílo ìbòmú lè dènà mọ́ Covid-19.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathe ama-63.8% walabo ababeyingxenye bebazi ukuthi i-Covid-19 ingavikeleka ngokugeza izandla, ukuqhelelana, ukugwema isixuku, nokusebenzisa isamfonyo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce kashi 63.8% na mahalarta sun san cewa ana iya hana cutar Covid-19 ta hanyar wanke hannu, nisantar jama'a, gujewa taron jama'a, da amfani da abin rufe fuska.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore 63.8% ya bakgathatema ba be ba tseba gore Covid-19 e ka thibelwa ka go hlapa diatla, go tlogela sekgoba magareng ga batho, go efoga fao go tletšego batho, le go apara maseke wa sefahlego.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ከተሳታፊዎቹ 63.8% የሚሆኑት እጅን በመታጠብ፣ ማህበራዊ ርቀትን በመጠበቅ፣ ህዝብ ከሚበዛባቸው ቦታዎች በመሸሽ እና የፊት ጭምብል በመጠቀም ኮቪድ-19ን መከላከል እንደሚቻል ያውቃሉ ብለዋል፡፡

Source: They also reported that only 18.6% of the public knew that they had to be isolated for 7 days if they had symptoms, and that their families would need to be isolated for 14 days.
Luganda: Baayongerako ne bagamba nti abantu abakola ebitundu 18.6% bokka be baali bakimanyi nti baalina okweyawula mu balala okumala ennaku 7 singa baafuna obubonero bw’endwadde, ate era nga bakimanyi nti famire zaabwe zaalina okweyawula mu bantu abalala okumala ennaku 14.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tú jábọ̀ pé àwọn 18.6% nínú àwùjọ náà ni wọ́n mọ̀ pé àwọn ní láti séra mọ́lé fún ọjọ́ 7 bí àwọn bá rí àmì àìsàn lára, àti pé àwọn ẹbí wọn yóò nílò láti séra mọ́lé fún ọjọ́ 14.
Zulu: Baphinde babika ukuthi i-18.6% kuphela womphakathi obuwazi ukuthi bekumele ugonqe izinsuku ezi-7 uma bekade benezimpawu, nokuthi imindeni yabo kumele yona igonqe izinsuku ezili-14.
Hausa: Sun kuma ba da rahoton cewa kashi 18.6% na jama'a ne kawai suka san cewa dole ne a ware su na tsawon kwanaki 7 idan suna da alamun cutar, kuma iyalansu za su buƙaci ware su na tsawon kwanaki 14.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba bega gape gore ke fela 18.6% ya setšhaba ye e bego e tyseba ba be ba swanetše go ipeela thoko matšatši a 7 ge eba ka ba le maswao, le gore ba malapa a bona le bona ba tla swanela ke go ipeela thoko mo matšatšing a 14.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም 18.6% የሚሆኑት የማህበረሰቡ ሰዎች ብቻ የህመም ምልክቶች ካጋጠሟቸው ለ7 ቀናት ተገልለው መቆየት እንዳለባቸው እና ቤተሰቦቻቸው ደግሞ ለ14 ቀናት ተገልለው መቆየት እንደሚያስፈልጋቸው ያውቁ እንደነበር ዘግበዋል፡፡

Source: The researchers also reported that 53.8% had a positive attitude, and 24.4% had good practices towards Covid-19.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza era baagamba nti abantu abakola ebitundu 53.8% baalina entwala ennungi, ate era abantu abakola ebitundu 24.4% beeyisanga mu ngeri eyambako okutangira Covid-19.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà tún jábọ̀ pé 53.8% ni wọhn kọ ìhà gidi sí i, nígbà tí 24.4% ń ṣẹ̀tọ́ nínú ìṣesí wọn sí covid-19.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baphinde babika ukuthi ama-53.8% abebe nesimo esihle senqondo, kanti ama-24.4% ubunomkhuba omuhle abawenzayo nge-Covid-19.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun kuma ba da rahoton cewa kashi 53.8% suna da kyakkyawan hali, kuma kashi 24.4% suna da kyawawan halaye ga cutar Covid-19.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba begile gape gore 53.8% ya bona ba bile le maikutlo a makaone, gomme 24.4% yona e bile le ditiro tše kaone mabapi le Covid-19.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ 53.8% አዎንታዊ አመለካከት እንዳላቸው እና 24.4% የሚሆኑት ኮቪድ-19ን በተመለከተ ጥሩ ልምምዶች እንዳሏቸው ጨምረው ዘግበዋል፡፡

Source: They said that 80% of the respondents did not know that there were no Covid-19 drugs and vaccines yet.
Luganda: Baagamba nti abeetabi abakola ebitundu 80% baali tebakimanyi nti eddagala erigema Covid-19 teryaliwo mu kiseera ekyo.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ní 80% àwọn olùdáhùn ni kò mọ̀ pé kò tí ì sí oògùn tàbí abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsára fún Covid-19.
Zulu: Bathe ama-80% walabo abaphendulile bebengazi ukuthi ibingakabibikho imithi nemigomo ye-Covid-19 esenziwe.
Hausa: Sun ce kashi 80% na waɗanda suka amsa ba su san cewa babu magunguna da alluran rigakafin cutar Covid-19 ba tukuna.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore 80% ya baarabi e be e sa tsebe gore ga go na le dihlare le meento ya Covid-19 go fihla ka nako yeo.
Amharic: ምላሽ ከሰጡት 80% የሚሆኑት የኮቪድ-19 መድሃኒቶች እና ክትባቶች እንዳልነበሩ አያውቁም ነበር ብለዋል፡፡

Source: More than half of respondents said traditional herbs or holy water could cure Covid-19.
Luganda: Abeetabi abakola ettundutundu erisinga obunene baagamba nti eddagala ly’ekinnansi oba amazzi amatukuvu byali bisobola okuwonya Covid-19.
Yoruba: Ó lé ní ìdajì àwọn olùdáhùn tí wọ́n sọ pè egbògi ìbílẹ̀ tàbi omi mímọ́ le wo Covid-19 sàn.
Zulu: Ngaphezulu kwengxenye yalabo abaphendulile bathe amakhambi esintu noma amanzi angcwele angayelapha i-Covid-19.
Hausa: Fiye da rabin masu amsa sun ce ganyayen gargajiya ko ruwa mai tsarki na iya warkar da cutar Covid-19.
Northern Sotho: Tekano ya go feta seripagare sa baarabi ba boletše gore mešunkwane goba meetse ao a galalelago a ka fodiša Covid-19.
Amharic: ከግማሽ በላይ የሚሆኑ ምላሽ ሰጪዎች ባህላዊ እጽዋት ወይም የተቀደሰ ውሃ ኮቪድ-19ን ሊፈውስ ይችላል ብለዋል፡፡

Source: Researchers observed that 47% of the respondents were against hand washing, social distancing, avoiding non-essential travel and self-isolation.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baazuula nti abeetabi abakola ebitundu 47% baali tebakkaanya na nkola ey’okunaaba mu ngalo, okwewa amabanga, okwewala okutambulatambula okutalina makulu awamu n’okweyawula mu bantu abalala.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí sàkíyèsí pé àwọn 47% nínú àwọn olùdáhùn ni wọ́n lòdì sí ọwọ́ fífọ̀, ìtakéte síra ẹni, yíyẹra fún ìrìn-àjò tí kò bá pàtàkì àti ìséra ẹni mọ́lé.
Zulu: Abacwaningi babhekile ukuthi ama-47% walabo abaphendulile bebephikisana nendaba yokugezwa kwezandla, ukuqhelelana, ukugwema izindlela ezingenaso isidingo kanye nokuzigonqa wena.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun lura cewa kashi 47% na masu amsa sun nuna adawa ga wanke hannu, nisantar jama'a, gujewa tafiye-tafiye marasa mahimmanci da ware kai.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba lemogile gore 47% ya baarabi ba be ba le kgajlanong le go hlapa diatla, go tlogela sekgoba magareng ga batho, go efoga maeto ao a sego bohlokwa le go ipeela thoko.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች 47% ምላሽ ሰጪዎች እጅ መታጠብን፣ ማህበራዊ ርቀት መጠበቅን፣ ካላስፈላጊ ጉዞ መቆጠብን እና ራስን ማግለልን እንደሚቃወሙ አስተውለዋል፡፡

Source: They said 31% of respondents never washed their hands with soap and 81.4% did not practice social distancing.
Luganda: Baagamba nti abeetabi abakola ebitundu 31% baali tebanaaba mu ngalo na ssabbuuni ate era ng’ebitundu 81.4% ku bo baali tebeewa mabanga.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ní 31% ̀wọn olùdáhùn ni wọn kì í fọṣẹ fọwọ́ wọn àti pé 81.4% ni kò ṣe ìtakété síra ẹni.
Zulu: Bathe ama-31% walabo abaphendulile awukaze wageza izandla zabo ngensipho kanti abama-81.4% awukaze uyenze indaba yokuqhelelana.
Hausa: Sun ce kashi 31% na waɗanda suka amsa ba su taɓa wanke hannayensu da sabulu ba kuma kashi 81.4% ba sa nisantar jama'a.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore 31% ya baarabi ga se ya ka ya hlapa diatla tša bona ka sesepa gomme 81.4% ya bona ga se ya tlogela sekgoba magareng ga bona le batho ba bangwe.
Amharic: ምላሽ ከሰጡት 31% እጃቸውን በሳሙና በፍጹም ያልታጠቡ ሲሆን 81.4% ደግሞ ማህበራዊ ርቀት መጠበቅን አልተገበሩም ብለዋል፡፡

Source: The researchers recommended educational campaigns to teach and encourage people to follow Covid-19 prevention measures.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baateesa wabeewo enteekateeka ezindererwamu okusomesa abantu okugoberera enkola z’okutangira Covid-19.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà dábàá ìpolongo ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ láti kọ́ àwọn ènìyàn àti láti gbà wọ́n ní ìyànjú pé kí wọn ó tẹ̀lé àwọn òté ìdènàmọ́ COVID-19.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bancome imikhankaso yokufunda ukuze ifundise nokukhuthaza abantu ukuthi balandele izindlela zokuvikela i-Covid-19.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ba da shawarar kamfen na ilimi don koyarwa da ƙarfafa mutane su bi matakan rigakafin cutar Covid-19.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba šišintše gore go dirwe masolo a thuto ka nepo ya go ruta le go hlohleletša batho go latela magato a thibelo ya Covid-19.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ሰዎች የኮቪድ-19ን መከላከያ እርምጃዎች እንዲከተሉ ለማስተማር እና ለማበረታታት ትምህርታዊ ዘመቻዎች እንዲደረጉ መክረዋል፡፡

Source: They also recommended more studies to evaluate the impact of the educational campaigns on the knowledge and practices of people throughout the pandemic in Ethiopia.
Luganda: Baayongerako era ne bateesa nti okunoonyereza okulala kusaanye kukolebwe okusobola okukebera enteekateeka z’okusomesa abantu kye zikoze ku kumanya n’ebikolwa by’abantu mu kiseera kyonna ekya nawookeera w’endwadde mu ggwanga lya Ethiopia.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sì tún dábàá ìwádìí síwájú sí i láti ṣàgbéyẹ̀wò ipa ìpolongo ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ lórí ìmọ̀ àti ìṣe àwọn ènìyàn kárí àjàkálẹ̀ àrùn náà ní Ethiopia.
Zulu: Baphinde bancoma izincwaningo ezengeziwe ukuhlola umthelela wemikhankaso yezemfundo kulwazi nakwimkhuba eyenziwa abantu kwimpathamhlaba e-Ethiopia.
Hausa: Sun kuma ba da shawarar ƙarin nazari don ƙimanta tasirin ilmantarwa da ilimi kan ayyukan mutane a duk lokacin annobar a Habasha.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba šišinya gape gore go dirwe dinyakišišo tše dingwe go sekaseka seabe sa masolo a thuto mabapi le tsebo le ditiro ka nakong ya leuba ka moka ka Ethiopia.
Amharic: እንዲሁም በኢትዮጵያ ወረርሽኝ ወቅት ትምህርታዊ ዘመቻው በህዝቡ እውቀት እና ተግባሮች ላይ የነበረውን ተጽእኖ ለመገምገም ተጨማሪ ጥናቶች እንዲደረጉ መክረዋል፡፡
